analogy.rationale: Antiarrhythmics act mainly on cardiac ion channels (sodium, calcium, potassium, HCN) and adrenergic receptors, targets that are minimally expressed or functionally silent in these non-cardiac cell lines, so transcriptional responses should be weak. The closest reference classes are other ion-channel blockers and adrenergic antagonists, which similarly produce little or no mRNA signature in these cells.
